options.name: ageingtime
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [ageing-time <0-1000000>] the Ethernet MAC address aging time, in seconds

options.name: arp_interval
options.description: This is only used with bond - ARP interval

options.name: arp_ip_target
options.description: This is only used with bond - ARP IP target

options.name: autoconnect
options.description: Whether the connection should start on boot. Whether the connection profile can be automatically activated

options.name: conn_name
options.description: Where conn_name will be the name used to call the connection. when not provided a default name is generated: <type>[-<ifname>][-<num>]

options.name: dhcp_client_id
options.description: DHCP Client Identifier sent to the DHCP server.

options.name: dns4
options.description: A list of upto 3 dns servers, ipv4 format e.g. To add two IPv4 DNS server addresses: "192.0.2.53 198.51.100.53"

options.name: dns4_search
options.description: A list of DNS search domains.

options.name: dns6
options.description: A list of upto 3 dns servers, ipv6 format e.g. To add two IPv6 DNS server addresses: "2001:4860:4860::8888 2001:4860:4860::8844"

options.name: dns6_search
options.description: A list of DNS search domains.

options.name: downdelay
options.description: This is only used with bond - downdelay

options.name: egress
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN egress priority mapping

options.name: flags
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - flags

options.name: forwarddelay
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [forward-delay <2-30>] STP forwarding delay, in seconds

options.name: gw4
options.description: The IPv4 gateway for this interface using this format ie: "192.0.2.1"

options.name: gw6
options.description: The IPv6 gateway for this interface using this format ie: "2001:db8::1"

options.name: hairpin
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - 'hairpin mode' for the slave, which allows frames to be sent back out through the slave the frame was received on.

options.name: hellotime
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [hello-time <1-10>] STP hello time, in seconds

options.name: ifname
options.description: Where IFNAME will be the what we call the interface name. interface to bind the connection to. The connection will only be applicable to this interface name. A special value of "*" can be used for interface-independent connections. The ifname argument is mandatory for all connection types except bond, team, bridge and vlan.

options.name: ingress
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN ingress priority mapping

options.name: ip4
options.description: The IPv4 address to this interface using this format ie: "192.0.2.24/24"

options.name: ip4_method
options.description: The IPv4 method to this interface using this format ie: "manual"

options.name: ip6
options.description: The IPv6 address to this interface using this format ie: "abbe::cafe"

options.name: ip6_dhcp_duid
options.description: A string containing the DHCPv6 Unique Identifier (DUID) used by the dhcp client to identify itself to DHCPv6 servers (RFC 3315). The special values "llt" and "ll" generate a DUID of type LLT or LL (see RFC 3315) based on the current MAC address of the device.

options.name: ip6_method
options.description: The IPv6 method to this interface using this format ie: "manual"

options.name: ip_tunnel_dev
options.description: This is only used with IPIP - parent device this IPIP tunnel, can use ifname.

options.name: ip_tunnel_local
options.description: This is only used with IPIP - IPIP local IP address.

options.name: ip_tunnel_remote
options.description: This is only used with IPIP - IPIP destination IP address.

options.name: mac
options.description: This is only used with bridge - MAC address of the bridge (note: this requires a recent kernel feature, originally introduced in 3.15 upstream kernel)

options.name: master
options.description: master <master (ifname, or connection UUID or conn_name) of bridge, team, bond master connection profile.

options.name: maxage
options.description: This is only used with bridge - [max-age <6-42>] STP maximum message age, in seconds

options.name: miimon
options.description: This is only used with bond - miimon

options.name: mode
options.description: This is the type of device or network connection that you wish to create for a bond, team or bridge.

options.name: mtu
options.description: The connection MTU, e.g. 9000. This can't be applied when creating the interface and is done once the interface has been created. Can be used when modifying Team, VLAN, Ethernet (Future plans to implement wifi, pppoe, infiniband)

options.name: path_cost
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - [<1-65535>] - STP port cost for destinations via this slave

options.name: primary
options.description: This is only used with bond and is the primary interface name (for "active-backup" mode), this is the usually the 'ifname'

options.name: priority
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge' - sets STP priority

options.name: slavepriority
options.description: This is only used with 'bridge-slave' - [<0-63>] - STP priority of this slave

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the device should exist or not, taking action if the state is different from what is stated.

options.name: stp
options.description: This is only used with bridge and controls whether Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) is enabled for this bridge

options.name: type
options.description: This is the type of device or network connection that you wish to create or modify. type C(generic) is added in version 2.5.

options.name: updelay
options.description: This is only used with bond - updelay

options.name: vlandev
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - parent device this VLAN is on, can use ifname

options.name: vlanid
options.description: This is only used with VLAN - VLAN ID in range <0-4095>

options.name: vxlan_id
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN ID.

options.name: vxlan_local
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN local IP address.

options.name: vxlan_remote
options.description: This is only used with VXLAN - VXLAN destination IP address.
